title: Cohort Capacity Dashboard & Autoscale Tuner
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a consolidated 'Cohort' view for Dedicated capacity that surfaces GPU pool health, predictive autoscaling impact, and low-friction burst tuning workflows. The cohort concept groups related GPU pools (by region, instance type, or customer segment) so operators can reason about capacity at meaningful scales. This ticket covers wireframes, high-fidelity prototype, and a lightweight interaction spec for the autoscale tuner (stepper + simulation overlay) and burst templates. Deliverables include Figma prototype, annotated handoff spec, and accessibility notes.
goals: Enable operators to quickly assess health across a cohort of GPU pools (utilization, preemptions, thermal throttling, queue depth)
Provide an autoscale tuning workflow with instant simulation of latency/cost trade-offs before applying policies
Offer safe burst templates that can be applied to multiple pools with rollbacks and SLO-aware guardrails
Keep UI complexity low for 80% of operational intents while exposing advanced knobs for platform engineers
constraints: Telemetry cardinality: cohort roll-up must perform without >2s panel load for cohorts up to 50 pools
Permissions: burst controls only available to users with tier:ops and policy-managed RBAC
Backend composition: autoscale simulator limited to historical 30d traces for quick approximation (no heavy on-demand compute)
Design must fit existing Console grid and theming; avoid introducing new global controls
decisions: Use a three-column layout: (1) cohort selector + summary, (2) cohort health timeline and alert strip, (3) tuner and action canvas
Simulator presents 3 scenarios (conservative, balanced, aggressive) with delta overlays for latency, cost, and error rate
Burst templates are modular artifacts (name, duration, capacity delta, throttling policy) that can be saved to a project-level library
Default view shows aggregated metrics with ability to drill down to per-pool rows; per-pool actions are contextual and require confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype covers cohort selection, health timeline, simulator overlay, and burst template editor
Design spec includes accessibility contrast checks, keyboard flows for the tuner stepper, and screen-reader labels for alerts
PRD alignment: console-2026.03 release notes include UX screenshots and rollout plan
Handoff-ready assets (components, tokens, microcopy) are uploaded to our design system board and linked from the ticket
